scope.legacy_receipt_boundary: Bounded Core transformation/native-byte binding under trusted compiler/linker/loader/libc/hardware; no general machine or whole-language proof.
scope.performance_boundary: One instrumented owned-byte kernel, finite registered sizes/seeds, one shared host, differing compiler implementations/LLVM versions, empirical batch timing. No general Rust parity, production demand, energy or complete human/tool acquisition cost claim.
scope.preregistration_boundary: Frozen protocol bytes and initial registrations are bound; this audit does not independently attest historical wall-clock order beyond original CI logs and static source flow.
